title: Clarify how the reference architecture relates to country architectures
requirements:
- State what an enterprise architecture is and how this reference architecture complements it
- Add a short explanation of the three concepts in the Chapter 3 lead
- Ask countries to document consequences and mitigations when elements are omitted or modified
- Make explicit that this is a reference architecture to adapt, not a prescribed end-state
- Separate the DPI-H, enterprise architecture and registry concepts
